subject: Leadership runway: wins + blockers, QBR asks
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>
To: Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@scalewave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership runway: wins + blockers, QBR asks

Team — sharing a short runway readout for this week ahead of QBR prep. High level: stable delivery velocity, one new commercial risk, and two asks for leadership ahead of Thursday's dry run. Attachment: QBR deck v2 (updated metrics slide).

Quick bullets (TL;DR)
- Wins: prod latency SLO improved 12% after kernel patch; Redwood Dedicated pilot signed with ScaleWave (SOW pending).
- Risks: pending SOC 2 evidence delay from infra vendor could affect private deployment go-live for a key customer (ScaleWave).
- Asks: (1) Approve a one-week extension on the ScaleWave rollout milestone pending compliance evidence; (2) ✅ Exec cover for a negotiated onboarding credit (proposed $25k) if procurement pushes timeline.

Details:
1) Engineering: throughput improvements holding across staging and canary. We pushed the kernel selection tuning; expect a ~10–15% cost reduction for token throughput in GA models. No action needed from leadership other than awareness.

2) ScaleWave commercial: verbal agreement in place. Procurement requested SOC 2 Type II evidence and an additional network diagram. Our infra partner has committed to produce artifacts but now says the earliest delivery is next Tuesday (was Friday). If we accept next-week delivery, ScaleWave requests a formal milestone extension and a reduced onboarding fee.

Requested decisions (please reply with short YES/NO)
- Approve milestone extension to 6/14 for ScaleWave onboarding? (impacts revenue recognition cadence).
- Approve offering a $25k credit (one-time) to keep the pilot timeline?

Attachments: [Attachment: qbr_deck_v2.pptx (PPTX - 3.2 MB)], [Attachment: runway_risk_register.csv (CSV - 48 KB)]

Thanks,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
VP, Strategy & Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe@redwood.com>, Leadership Distro <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Emma Torres <emma@scalewave.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership runway: wins + blockers, QBR asks

Chloe — short responses and one operational ask.

1) Approve the milestone extension to 6/14: YES. We should avoid hard stop and maintain trust with ScaleWave. If leadership is aligned, I'll notify legal/procurement and update the SOW draft.

2) $25k credit: PROVISIONALLY YES, pending confirmations below (we should reserve credit approval until legal signs the SOW amendment). Rationale: keeps the pilot live and increases likelihood of expanding to Dedicated.

Operational ask: can someone from platform (Jonas) expedite the vendor SOC ingestion? If we can get the artifact by EOD Tuesday we can keep the onboarding cadence with minimal slippage. Jonas, can you prioritize?

Also: small edit to slide 7 in the deck — swap the throughput delta chart with the latencies chart (users will ask). I updated the doc comment.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Marissa / Chloe — I'm on it. Quick operational note: we've escalated to the infra partner's SOC owner and opened a shared Confluence space. They indicated they can commit the final evidence by end of day Tuesday if we provide a short list of missing docs (we already did). I'll ping again and post updates to the Drive link.

If the artifact slips, plan B: offer a temporary limited-data onboarding configuration (VPC-only, no archived logs) so ScaleWave can run initial validation. That reduces risk exposure while legal works the SOW amendment.

I'll update the risk register with the plan B path and ETA.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
